entries.8ed8004514b5e2e6: This is a cloud-based WAF that detects, blocks and visualizes cyber attacks on Web applications. The company provides everything from development to operation, sales and support, and payment is received on a subscription (monthly billing) basis according to the period of use. Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,683 million.

entries.c827840434f6cf81: An service that automatically operates WAF rules provided by public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, using AI and big data. entries.e034d0bc153c80d4: These include the vulnerability information collection and management tool "SIDfm," vulnerability assessment services, AWS WAF Managed Rules, the fully managed security service "CloudFastener," and the Web privacy protection automation service "webtru." entries.ee43e8e80f2d3399: This is a single-segment business centered on Web application security services. Centered on the cloud-based WAF "Kogeki Shadan-kun" and the automated WAF operation service "WafCharm," it provides a vulnerability information collection and management tool and a fully managed security service for cloud environments. The consolidated subsidiaries are 3 companies: Cyber Security Cloud Inc., which sells the company's products in the United States; Generative Technology Co., Ltd., which does contract development; and DataSign Co., Ltd., which develops and sells products. Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥5,084 million.
